model.pn_kc_weight: binary adjacency normalized by each covered KC PN indegree
model.noise: input-only frozen repeat jitter; no state or process noise

tau_k_ms.source: No direct mapping found; electrophysiology context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12487611/
tau_k_ms.reason: round engineering low-pass constant; no independently validated MaleCNS KC value maps to this proxy equation

tau_apl_ms.reason: APL feedback is slower than the KC proxy by design; no unique whole-cell APL constant is available for this scalar proxy

input_scale.unit: dimensionless state per normalized PN rate
input_scale.source: Model normalization convention; no biological numeric source
input_scale.reason: fixes the normalized model scale to one and removes a redundant free scaling degree

apl_gain.reason: unit feedback gain tests the validated qualitative inhibitory direction without fitting its magnitude

threshold.reason: 0.35 requires substantial coincident normalized PN drive and is fixed analytically, not from formal outputs

active_mean_rate_threshold.reason: fixed response classifier for the proxy rate; not a biological firing threshold

population.uncovered_kc_report_policy: append 138 structural zeros only for secondary full-population metrics

topology_controls.seed_derivation: little-endian uint64 from first 8 bytes of SHA256('STONKFLY-V2/M1/TOPOLOGY-C/v1/{index}')

statistics.between_odor_match: three highest noiseless-base PN cosine neighbors per odor; descending cosine then ascending odor index; compare same repeat index
statistics.separation_statistic: T_sep=mean over 16 odors of R_o-D_o; median margin is descriptive only
statistics.separation_null: fixed-seed Monte Carlo sign-flip of the 16 odor-level paired margins R_o-D_o using their mean; odors, not trials, are the exchangeability units
